title: Major Themes in Modern Philosophies of Judaism
attributionNote: Authorship follows the Sefaria catalogue record for this work. Where a text is traditionally attributed or collectively compiled, the library does not assert a single author beyond the source's own metadata.
description: Analysis and critique of thinkers like Martin Buber, Franz Rosenzweig, Abraham Joshua Heschel, and Mordecai Kaplan. Complete Jewish Thought text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Jewish philosophy and theology argue about God, revelation, law and the human good. These works belong to their own schools and arguments; the library does not flatten them into a single Jewish doctrine.
